# Fortune Haven — Ultra Luxury Villas
> A private collection of 24 ultra luxury 4-BHK private residences in Devanahalli, Bengaluru North, along the NH-207 corridor.

## Project Overview
Fortune Haven is an exclusive gated residential enclave developed by Cannas Lily Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. (JCN Group). The development features twenty-four distinctive Ultra Luxury private residences thoughtfully envisioned for a life shaped by space, privacy, and architectural distinction.

- **Typology**: 4-Storey Private Residences (B+G+2 / 4 Levels)
- **Scale**: Limited enclave of 24 residences
- **Built-up Area**: 4,281 sq ft per villa
- **Undivided Land Share (UDS)**: 2,800 sq ft
- **Approvals & Status**: OC Received • BIAAPA Approved • RERA PRM/KA/RERA/1250/303/PR/191015/002912 • Model Villa Ready
- **Location**: NH-207, Devanahalli, Bengaluru North, Karnataka 562110, India
- **Geographic Coordinates**: 13.2575 deg N, 77.7097 deg E
- **Regional Connectivity**: Direct access along the NH-207 corridor, 200 m from NH-44, 1 km from STRR, 15 km from Kempegowda International Airport (BLR), 11 km from Amazon & Walmart Global Capability Centres.

## Architectural Levels & Floor Distribution
- **Level 01 (Basement / Stilt Floor)**: Arrival forecourt, three-car covered parking bay, two-wheeler slots, dedicated home office / utility room, private central lift, internal staircase, and landscaped entrance garden.
- **Level 02 (Ground Floor)**: Private lawn and driveway, entrance porch, double-height living salon, dining room, gourmet kitchen with breakfast island, guest bedroom suite with attached bathroom, and rear private yard.
- **Level 03 (First Floor)**: Primary master sanctuary suite with private dressing area and ensuite, intimate family lounge, central lift access, and private open terrace framed by perimeter planters.
- **Level 04 (Second Floor)**: Two additional bedroom suites with dressing areas and ensuite bathrooms, secondary TV lounge, private balconies, and an architectural double-height opening overlooking the dining area below.

## Private Outdoor Living & Enclave Amenities
- **Sunlit Rooftop Lookout Terrace**: Panoramic open-air terrace perched atop each villa offering unobstructed vistas of the Nandi Hills and Skandagiri foothill contours.
- **Dusk Entertaining Lounge**: Open-sky rooftop leisure zone crafted for unhurried evenings.
- **Enclave Swimming Pool**: Residential aquatic sanctuary with landscaped stone sun deck and integrated shallow water section.
- **Community Clubhouse**: Dedicated social pavilion for neighborly recreation and casual gatherings.
- **Private Study & Library**: Quiet internal sanctum tailored for intellectual focus and acoustic seclusion.
- **Balconies & Courtyards**: Deep shaded overhangs and 4 private bedroom verandahs framing manicured gardens.
